name: 55103 · Saint Paul, MN
findings: ZIP 55103 (Saint Paul) has 164 nonprofit organizations. 93 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 83 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55103 (Saint Paul) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 55103 (Saint Paul) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 5.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 83 organizations here; 20% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
